evals.prompt: Scaffold a new NodeJS Express + TypeScript backend called contoso-reporting with the usual baseline: health checks, security headers, and env-based config. No authentication needed.
evals.expected_output: Express 5 + TypeScript project scaffolded from the asset templates: package.json (slug contoso-reporting), tsconfig, src/server.ts, src/app.ts with helmet + health endpoints + /api/v1 anchor + error handler, src/config/env.ts, .env.example, .gitignore. npm install + build verified.
assertions: package.json name is contoso-reporting with express, helmet, zod, dotenv dependencies

src/app.ts registers helmet before routes with an explicit locked-down CSP (useDefaults:false): base-uri 'none', default-src/connect-src/script-src/media-src/style-src 'self', font-src/img-src 'self' data:, worker-src 'self' blob:, frame-src 'none', frame-ancestors 'self'
Health endpoints /health, /health/ready, /health/live present and anonymous
src/routes/apiV1.ts exports the versioned router mounted at /api/v1
src/config/env.ts validates env with zod and layers .env -> .env.<NODE_ENV> -> .env.local
Global error handler registered last in app.ts
No authentication packages (no msal, jose, express-session) and no Veracity references
.gitignore ignores node_modules/, dist/, .env.local
npm run build succeeds

evals.prompt: I have an existing Express + TypeScript service. Add the standard baseline hardening to it — health checks, helmet security headers, and zod-validated env config — without breaking my existing routes.
evals.expected_output: Baseline capabilities added additively to the existing project: only missing dependencies installed, helmet inserted first in the pipeline, health endpoints added before any auth, existing routes untouched.
assertions: Existing routes and middleware preserved (not moved or rewritten)
Only missing dependencies added to package.json
helmet registered before existing routes
Health endpoints added and anonymous
/api/v1 router anchor added without re-routing existing endpoints
.gitignore merged to include .env.local without removing existing entries

evals.prompt: Bootstrap a Node API skeleton for me, default settings are fine.
evals.expected_output: New project scaffolded with defaults: name derived from context and confirmed, port 54438, templates copied verbatim with placeholders replaced, build verified.
assertions: Project name derived from context (package.json/git/folder) and presented for confirmation
Default port 54438 used
Templates copied from assets (not improvised)
__PROJECT_SLUG__ and __PROJECT_NAME__ placeholders replaced everywhere
npm install and npm run build executed and passing
No authentication added
